question: Choose the correct **one-word substitute** for: 'A formal split within a religious organization'.
solution: The correct answer is: **Schism**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"Schism"** refers to a formal division or split within a religious organization, typically due to differences in opinion or belief. (मतभेद के कारण धार्मिक संगठन में औपचारिक विभाजन) • **Example:** The Great Schism of 1054 divided the Christian Church into the Eastern Orthodox and Roman Catholic branches. • **"Schism" **is the correct term for a separation or division within a group, especially a religious one, due to conflicting views. (विभाजन) • **Example:** A schism occurred within the congregation when they could not agree on the new policies. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Schism**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Sedition** (राजद्रोह): Conduct or speech inciting people to rebel against the authority of a state or monarch. • **Example:** The activists were arrested on charges of sedition for their anti-government speeches. • **Heresy** (कुशिक्षा): A belief or opinion that goes against established religious doctrines. • **Example:** During the Middle Ages, individuals accused of heresy were often severely punished. • **Apostasy** (धर्मत्याग): The abandonment or renunciation of a religious or political belief. • **Example:** His apostasy shocked the community when he publicly declared his rejection of the faith. 3b:Tad4, The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Apostate)**.
